content:
hugo: Heads up—Nimbus has been spotted on the projector during the all-hands. I repeat, Nimbus on the projector. :eyes:
maya: OMG 😂
andre: who is Nimbus
maya: The conference-room cat (totally unofficial). He lives on top of the AV rack. Legend says he approves presentations.
liz: I swear he gave my quarterly deck a disapproving stare last week.
sam: can we make him an official mascot? petition in #random?
hugo: vote: :thumbsup: for Official Nimbus, :thumbsdown: for Eternal Feline Overlord
ops-bot: Poll created by hugo — 1) Official Nimbus 2) Eternal Feline Overlord (poll open 24h)
maya: also proposing a tiny cape. mandatory.
andre: cape should be made from an old Redwood t-shirt. sustainable kapow.
liz: also can we add "Nimbus Approval" emoji reaction? :cat_face:
sam: I've made a low-effort GIF of Nimbus wearing a cape: http://imgur.com/xyz123
maya: :rotating_light: important: please don't actually put him on the projector, he almost knocked the HDMI cable into the abyss last time.
andre: noted. also, if Nimbus adopts my keyboard again, I will accept it as fate.
hugo: Grand ceremony planned for Friday: Nimbus Coronation at 3pm near the big plant. Bring treats. :treat:
maya: I'm bringing catnip-shaped cookies (vegan)
ops-bot: Reminder set for Friday 15:00 — "Nimbus Coronation" (channel: random)
sam: 3pm works for me. photo evidence required.
liz: agreed. Nimbus Song suggestions welcome. I vote the 'cat version' of "Eye of the Tiger".
hugo: perfect. see you there. :crown:
